title: OpenIOC Consumer Profile
description: Declarative description of the OpenIOC subset supported by a specific consumer product (e.g. KATA KEDR, FireEye HX).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this profile format. The engine checks that the major component matches its supported major version.

name.description: Short, unique identifier used as the registry key (e.g. 'kedr', 'fireeye-hx'). Must be stable across profile updates.

profile_version.description: Semantic version of this profile's data. Increment when the vendor changes their supported terms or operators.

target_product.description: Human-readable name of the target product (e.g. 'KATA KEDR').

target_versions.description: Product version(s) these constraints apply to. Informational only — the engine does not interpret this field.

description.description: Free-form description of the profile and its purpose.

source.description: URL pointing to the official documentation that defines these constraints.

terms.description: Allowed terms. Keys are Context.search strings (e.g. 'FileItem/FileName'). Omit entirely to allow all terms.

operators.description: Condition values permitted for this term (e.g. 'is', 'contains', 'matches').

content_types.description: Content.content_type values permitted for this term (e.g. 'string', 'md5'). Omit to allow any content type.

description.description: Human-readable note about this term's constraints.

structure.description: Structural constraints on the indicator tree. Omit to apply no structural limits.

max_nesting.description: Maximum depth of Indicator nesting (1 = root only, 2 = root + one level, …). Omit for no limit.

allow_or_at_top_level.description: Whether the root Indicator may use the OR operator. Defaults to true.

allow_or_inside_and.description: Whether an OR Indicator may appear as a child of an AND Indicator. Defaults to true.

allow_and_inside_or.description: Whether an AND Indicator may appear as a child of an OR Indicator. Defaults to true.

mappings.description: Optional term-rewrite hints for the adapter (reserved for future use in v1). Keys and values are Context.search strings.
